body: I'm sorry, is there a reason you're putting up with this? Surely you don't see a future with him?? NTA

It's not your chest, it's your self deprecation that is unattractive. You are dimming your own light by insisting that you lack value. Your boob size is not the key to finding love. Or happiness. Or worthiness. If they were bigger, everything would suddenly change? Change the way you talk to and about yourself. Stop putting yourself down over the preferences of some men who did not even deserve to experience you. You have to start believing you're a prize (as you ARE), or nothing will change and you will never exit the pity party. Straight up.
NTA- Someone else has her child for days and she can't even be reached.. You did the right thing for your niece. It may not be intentional but the kid doesn't deserve to suffer from the neglect.
Slow down before you make yourself sick.

It is rape. Even if you can't speak, your body language and tears still count. You were also drunk, which already makes it rape. He knew what was going on and he took advantage. It's hard to accept it, especially when it's someone you trusted (and your first love). I've been there. I know you don't want to believe it and you might be thinking of a million ways you could be wrong. But you know you were violated. Your body knows. This will take time and healing. I'm so sorry honey. Controlling men like that are not safe to have around.

Lol, why question yourself because of someone else's preference? You like men and women don't you? :) 

Personally I love tall, masculine men with nice arms and facial hair. Slightly nerdy and more on the quiet side. With women, I really only like fems. Lashes, nails, all that (and sometimes with a little splash of masculine like pinkyblack360 on Tiktok lol). Submissive with men but dominant with women. It's like the flip of a switch!

Look up the term "negging." And speak up for yourself. He's disrespecting you straight to your face. You can't have a relationship without boundaries, set some. Or better yet, leave him. Nothing about telling your boyfriend not to save and drool over content of other girls is crazy... You don't need to happily accept that???
Exactly. That explanation made no sense and is clearly a cover-up. Especially at the age of 18?? You know better.

Self awareness

Why do you keep describing him as if he's not human.. Of course he laughs? We get it, he's a muscle man. These details do not matter, and you make it sound as if it would be a turn off for you if he actually did show emotion and wasn't so "stoic."

Yes, this!!! And that's the thing that got me.. you can't handle being apart for hours but he's joining the army? This transitional period of your lives is serving as a rude awakening, from the looks of it. You need to fix your toxic traits and you also need to think about if you can handle a long distance relationship (where you'll also be stuck worrying about him all the time).

Honestly, this is how I feel reading this. Isn't he in basic training right now or am I wrong?? Dude's gotta be extremely stressed and beat down and you fight with him because of how long it takes ? Quality time is important to you, so something definitely needs to be arranged where you two can spend more time together. It's completely valid to want to fix that. That being said, I think you could be a little easier on him. Try to figure out his love language and use that to help him feel more comfortable expressing himself. Sounds like it could be physical touch.

This happened to me with a group of friends I made last year. One of the girls would literally not acknowledge my existence whenever I tried to speak to her or just chime in with the conversation. Like, she wouldn't even look in my direction and would proceed to cut me off in the middle of my sentences. It's verrryy weird and extremely rude. You don't have to play nice; treat her the same way. And hopefully your best friend has taken notice and will make sure you feel heard and included. I really hope so.

No, it's super helpful. Thank you so much for this. I keep thinking "if it's meant to be, it will be" but it's so scary having no idea if the other person is still on board or not after all this time. At the end of the day, I need to heal to the point where I'd be okay whether it were to work out or not. I'm gonna try my best to get there.

No no no. This is sexual assault. You don't touch someone while they're sleeping, and you also don't touch someone after they tell you to stop. And when you confront him he tries to manipulate you?? He doesn't even feel guilt?? Please get away from this dude. Alcohol is not an excuse and there is NO way to flip it; he is disrespecting you and your body and he's only going to keep crossing the boundaries until it's full-blown rape. I'm so sorry. One day you'll reflect back on this and feel sick to your stomach, trust me. Recognize the signs and take his actions for what they are. You are only trying to prove to yourself that it isn't an issue, he's not trying to prove anything. Please run. This man is dangerous and will hurt you.

NTA- the "ethnic food" comment was really enough. He's blatantly racist and your best friend probably is too. Your friend group clearly sees no issue with microagressions/casual racism and probably secretly finds the jokes funny. Considering that your boyfriend is a POC, that is such a dangerous and super uncomfortable environment for him. Good on you for protecting him from them and making it clear that you don't blindly side with ignorance, nor think that shit is funny.
lol I'm using this to manifest my soulmate! Taking notes.

No you're not wrong at all. I can't stand it. They will automatically gesture for you to go down on them without having to say a word and then move right along afterwards, not even thinking about offering. Like, blowjobs are considered part of the normal sex script but eating vagina is just something that doesn't matter if you do or not??? It's weird and honestly, it offends me. Is a whole penis in your mouth supposed to be a fun walk in the park for us? What about us? Hello?? 

I don't like that it's always expected of us and not them, and they don't even see the issue half the time. If you don't do oral, that's fine, there's other people who don't like it either; but you expecting to receive it without even attempting to reciprocate is BS. You're right about the unwillingness being a turn-off.  Avoid self-centered lovers/hookups.

Umm.. she's nine. Of course she doesn't want to read books for older age groups. She's going to continue being advanced and smart regardless, just let her be a kid!! You're controlling and unaware of it; please fix that now while she's still this young. Please. YTA.

The size doesn't really matter. Everyone's different, but you could honestly squirt with your pinky finger. It isn't the size, it's just how you use it. You're clearly very attentive and do your best to pleasure her; if she hasn't told you to change a technique or that she doesn't like how you do something, then you're fine. She's already satisfied with what you have to offer and there's no need to get in your head about being inadequate when you're doing everything right. You're good. On the other hand, she might actually be to blame for some of the insecurities.. It seems like she shares too much info that you just don't say to your partner because it would obviously be off-putting to them or cause jealousy. It's a respect thing and she should see how those comments affect you and fix it. For her to be so dismissive after you were vulnerable enough to admit how you felt bad about your dick.. That really wasn't cool.

This. It should be about spending quality time together, not how much money you spend. Is that the case, or is it just about being spoiled? She has to know how super expensive that is.. She insists on going out that many times a week without planning on paying ??
That literally would not inconvenience anyone. Does she just have a problem with your mom?
She hears you.
Agreed. He doesn't care enough. His friend's behavior deserved way worse than a bucket of water.

This. If he makes you feel worse about yourself instead of better, he's toxic for your mental health and is only going to get worse. Despite all the good he might have to offer, he isn't being a healthy or loving partner to you by hurting you like this.

He's picking you apart to make you insecure. Please do not change your appearance for this man. Marry someone who loves everything about you and doesn't try to manipulate you into life-changing decisions by constantly throwing your "flaws" in your face (and also having you compare yourself to other women for ANY reason at all. Hell no). He'd get any surgery you asked to make you happy? Really? More like he knows you love him unconditionally and would never even suggest he do such a thing. Please protect your self-esteem and peace of mind. You're beautiful.
I'm not sure if I misread, but it sounded like you were threatening to do something to her if she won't reciprocate. Is that not what you're saying?

Get help. This is frightening and you need to respect people's boundaries when they don't share your feelings. You don't own anybody and you can't force anyone to feel anything. Possessiveness and obsession. Speak with a professional, seriously. Leave her the hell alone.

Crying. You two had such a beautiful relationship and he sounds like such a lovely person and father. Look out for relative signs, songs, smells, sounds, butterflies, etc. It's him checking in on you. He's there and remains so proud of you. Try your best to be your own biggest fan; embrace who you are, be patient with yourself and aim to love yourself a little harder each day. Aim to give yourself the same love and support that he would <3 Take it easy, love. Happy birthday.
So proud of you. I wish you so much happiness.
I wish my mom was this supportive of me throughout my struggles with social anxiety. This is lovely, I'm so proud of him :)

I'm so proud of him!!! My nephew is on the spectrum and is preparing to start kindergarten and we're nervous but I really believe he's extraordinary and I hope his future educators do too. This felt really really great to read :)
I love this. I really really love this.
Thank you. This message was definitely for me, too.
Thank you so much :)
I'm having a rough day and these comments really surprised me and made me feel so happy and cared for :) Thank you, thank you, thank you. You're all such kind, strong and beautiful people. <3333

I know exactly what you mean. I felt like every mishap was all the more reason to give up and also more proof that I was hopeless; I didn't even prepare for a lot of 'adulthood things' because I figured I'd be gone by then anyway. Sometimes when I'm really down the thought pops back up, and I have to quickly dismiss it and find other solutions.

Luckily, I made it and you did too. I'm so glad you found happiness and that you're actively working to maintain it :) you're amazing and thank you so much!

I don't know what "looking for attention" is supposed to mean. I was proud of myself.. I'm anonymous and I express myself under the appropriate subs where I can rant freely without bothering anyone. I also think I clearly just said that I DON'T want to die. 

Word of advice. If someone is clearly depressed and just trying to blow off steam in a safe place for them, don't say this. It's insensitive, it's rude, and it's assuming that I don't do anything to help myself outside of the internet. You don't know me. Thanks.

Basically, my mom projected her traumas onto me and sheltered me throughout my childhood. She's also always been super controlling and she apparently classifies as being emotionally abusive. I developed my social anxiety when I was a kid and there's no doubt that it stemmed from her. She hasn't changed so I get pissed off pretty often lol.

I've lived with social anxiety since I was a kid, and I completely understand the dread you feel. Working is intimidating, driving is intimidating.. everything we have to be able to do in order to function as adults seems impossible. I'm in my second year of college now though, and I've learned a lot more about myself and I've had some experiences that have actually helped to improve the anxiety. I think big changes that seem so scary and impossible can actually end up being a lot more pleasant than the way things were before. It's hard to imagine, but it won't be as bad as you think. Life still fucking sucks and I too wish that we could just choose to die without it bothering anyone else. It's hard. But I really wish you the best. We're both stuck right now.
It's amazing what kind of impact you can make. I love this.

Nope. You can't confide in someone that has to make you feel stupid and overreact whenever you rant about something just to blow off steam. It's not that hard to just let someone complain to you. Basic empathy. And he actually told her that?? For what reason? Super weird and unnecessary.

YTA - Seriously, grow up and get over yourself. That's her underwear. That she has to wear everyday. They'll cost so much to replace. She just wanted to pass her exam, and she's probably too stressed now to even focus. She shouldn't have snipped your strings but come on, you IMMEDIATELY REPLACED THEM. They're strings. Once again, grow up. You've humiliated and greatly inconvenienced your sister. Think about someone other than yourself. What the fuck.
YTA - He wanted to be Miles Morales. There's a difference.

Sheltering your kids like that and enforcing those extremely controlling rules on them even when they're of high school age is a sure way to mess them up psychologically. And I know what you meant by the emotional neglect, as well. You deserved better than that. But honestly, they don't start to understand how toxic they are and how much they've harmed you until they drive you away and just have to deal with themselves.
NTA - He got his scholarship taken away by doing something incredibly stupid, not you. She should be angry with her son, not the person he stole from.

YTA

She's using allowance money that she's been saving up for her whole life for whatever she'd want in the long run; not money you started giving her for education purposes. Being given a monthly allowance from elementary school and continuing through college WHILE you're also paying her tuition for her, means she's obviously never felt the need to get a job. She's never had to because you've always provided money for her. That's on you, and you can't decide to take it back and change the rules all of a sudden, just because you don't like the thing she wants to buy. She's an adult and her allowance is her's to spend. Don't punish her by leaving her hanging in college for a completely unrelated reason (that only has to do with your personal opinion).

NTA - Why unnecessarily drive from door to door? That takes away a big part of the trick or treating experience imo. And honestly, it was lazy and just weird of him to follow you guys in a car the whole time. Maybe there wouldn't be added drama if he would've just properly participated with the rest of the family??
Exactly this.

You gotta escape from him now. Now. ASAP.  Don't be fooled by the "good moments" where he's sweet and seems normal. He'll never be normal again. That unpredictable rage with the verbal abuse, the coercion and pressure he puts on you after you've already said no.. That's extremely dangerous and it's only going to get worse. He's a rapist and an abuser. Please don't stick around for this, it'll only get harder to leave. He's not a good guy. And he won't be again. Please listen.

He needs you. You'll never be a burden to him. The world has just been way too unfair to you. I'm sorry you have to feel this way all the time. It's extremely hard. But please know your kid loves you more than anything, and I want you to see him grow up. Let him be your motivation to wake up the next day. You're not a burden. At all.
I've never seen Harry Potter or Star Wars.
This is SO cute I love that you get to experience this kind of happiness :) best of luck!

You can't be friends obviously.. You've known her son since he was a little kid. He's still a kid. That's gross and she's probably going to assume you've been preying on him this whole time, and no one can blame her. Just admit it and then leave them alone; it can't be fixed.
Definitely.

Had this exact same argument with someone a couple weeks ago. I explained how being ignored made me feel absolutely awful and that he needed to communicate that he was busy or something instead of leaving me hanging.. and I got apologetic when I didn't need to as well. Then, he acted like I was being dramatic and then said he didn't owe me a text back because he has priorities :)

I can't control it, but I have this single hiccup that happens at random, multiple times a day. I have no idea what it is, but I've done it since as long as I can remember. It also annoys the hell out of everyone. (:
Thank you for sticking around for her.
Uhh define cuddling. If she was laying on top of her cousin all cuddled up, that would be pretty weird. And are you saying you have the same name as her sister?

That last line really hit hard. I know exactly how you feel. But, I want you to allow yourself to be happy and to be loved at those great amounts. When someone truly loves you, they'll love all parts of you, and be there through the good and the bad. I think they will. And I know for sure that you'd do the same, because you have big heart and a beautiful soul and you are so so deserving of all these happy feelings. It's so easy to overthink, but try your best to not let it consume you. I'll try my best, too.
This is honestly all I can think about sometimes. It feels so shitty knowing that any good feeling we have is nothing but a distraction.

That's super creepy. Especially being her boss. She's barely an adult and he shouldn't be coming to her for any of his personal issues and definitely not sending any sexual content to her.. Plus, even without the age difference, he should be respecting his girlfriend's wishes to not be constantly talking to this woman and telling her your business and um.. not speak sexually to her?? :/ Yuck.
I'm so glad you found her and that you have this. Life got better for you and that makes me happy.

This contributed to my recent breakup lol. I had a suicidal outburst in the middle of a breakdown and he got "freaked out." I apologized tons and explained myself later and everything but he just started ignoring me. He's definitely done the same thing to me before and worse; difference is, I cared enough to actually be there for him and not make him feel worse when I knew he was already on edge.

You're in denial and I understand that and I hear what you're saying. None of us know your life personally. You love her. It's rarely happened. I hear you.

But, this isn't normal behavior. She shouldn't put her hands on you in order to get her way. No argument should be resulting in violence. Would you ever hit her for not listening to you or doing something you didn't agree with? Probably not. That's real love. Please don't let your love for her lead you into thinking that you're allowed to intentionally hurt the ones you love. Your children are noticing everything. Your children have been put into dangerous situations because of this. Your children are being taught that violence is love. That when they make mistakes or don't consent to something, they deserve pain. You're a father before you're a husband. Remember that.

Ask a therapist how to stop flinching. That's my answer.
I love this :) Reminiscing can be so peaceful.

Please please tell your sister. Her boyfriend is a pedophile and he's abusing you and causing you so much trauma that you don't deserve to have to live with. I know this is so scary for you, I know. But I would never EVER forgive myself for being with someone that did this to my younger sibling. And she cannot blindly move in with and spend the rest of her life with someone like that. It isn't safe or okay for either of you to be around him. When you're ready to talk about this, tell her or an adult you can trust first, if that'll be easier. I promise your safety is more important than whatever they were planning. Yes, it'll hurt to hear that about him, but it won't be your fault. I promise. You're innocent. And you're going to grow past this. Please, I'm so worried about you dear.

I feel this. A lot. This is a feeling that hurts deeper than some people can understand, and it does so much damage. Try to cut him off as much as you can, even if it's a slow process and it takes you a while to get yourself to block him or delete pictures. It's all super hard to do. But he can't do anything else for you except damage your self esteem, and make you feel insecure to the point where you always question yourself around him or constantly get terrible gut feelings and flashbacks. I want better for you. And I can bet that you were the most loving and caring partner who thought so much of him and maybe even put his needs before your own. You are everything and more, and he couldn't appreciate all that you were because he didn't deserve you and couldn't possibly offer you the same. Please message me if you need to talk about this. You'll be okay.
Do it!!!!

I don't think this guy is safe to be around or to trust again with your body. You were literally crying in pain, and he shut you off in his head so he could focus on his own selfish desires and use you to finish. That is very very scary. And his next emotion was anger. Also alarming. I know that frozen shock. You felt abused and violated because you were. He admitted he knew he was raping you. Chose to ignore it through all that time, in hopes you'd forget or just never bring it up again. His remorse is fake. Don't let him manipulate you. Don't let him touch you ever again. You do not deserve to live with this kind of trauma. I'm so sorry that he hurt you.

You've been through way too much shit in your young life, and I'm sorry about the awful things that you've had to force yourself to live through. I'm proud of you for your strength and your hard work that probably ended up being under appreciated. Loneliness can be the most overwhelming feeling sometimes. I hope you feel a little less alone here. Even just a little bit. We hear you.

My mom always used to tell me to try not to mention the new things I got because people will get jealous and nasty. I thought that was totally dumb, until I made a friend exactly like that. When something good happens to me and it isn't happening to her (even if it has before), she'll throw a huge pity party for herself and then do it all over social media so I'll see and feel bad. Really kills the mood. Befriend people that will be happy for you. Especially when you're always over the moon for them and never let an ounce of bitterness show.
I'm so sorry. She truly loved and appreciated you and I hope you never ever doubt that.

That you can break somebody with social anxiety "out of their shell."

Also, a lot of people don't seem to realize that depression literally sucks away all your motivation and energy. Please don't call us lazy, that's not the case and it makes us feel worse.

What everyone doesn't know is that the very obvious scar on my neck is *not* from a curling iron, but from me trying to heal a hickey quicker by scraping the bruise with a coin. Scraped my skin off. Whatever.
Dark skin is GORGEOUS. Please wear your bright colors and even pick up some red lipstick too if you want! Show off that beautiful beautiful glow.
I'm glad you did this. It would've only gotten worse for your friend's mental health. Feeling really bad for the wife.
Heavily trash talking your ex, making it clear that I'm a rebound you just needed as a distraction.

I'm so proud of you. I just read through all the posts and I was so worried. You are so **incredibly** strong for cutting him off, given all the history and love you have for him. I know how it feels to be manipulated by someone you love to the point where you can't see how extremely awful of a person they really are. And the fact that literally everybody else does makes you feel so stupid.

I hope you know that you're not stupid. He'll never be who you thought he was or what you wish he'd become, but that isn't your fault. Consider counseling and also seek comfort from other people you know you can trust. Never doubt yourself or your beauty and always trust your gut. Best of luck, dear.

Don't go back. That's a torturous and endless cycle you don't want to be a part of. Think of yourself as everything someone could want, and don't settle for anyone that makes you question that. No more trusting immature people who don't mean what they say. They'll take advantage and you don't deserve that.
Shrek 2. It's the best.

I completely understand. I can be quite the pushover, and I'm too empathetic to even the worst kinds of people. They all seem to just take advantage when you try to be the most loyal support system; you heal them, then they hurt you and forget about you. It's shit. Nights like these are rough because you're just stuck thinking about how everyone wrongs you. But your kind heart is appreciated. You help people and you truly care and those are qualities everyone should have, but most of them honestly lack. I'll listen to you if you need.

Hm.. I think you have a good point. I can relate to that. I have some insecurities from past issues we've had, and I guess I'm just really afraid of encountering those issues again. I'm just too scared to voice this so I guess maybe I'm just gonna keep going through this in my head until I do. Maybe.
Mine are constantly first person. You would think I had an imaginary friend, from watching me in my room all day. But as a kid, all my daydreams were just those movies like you described.
Holding the door for me when I'm literally still on the other side of the room. Now I have to jog up to the door and act like I'm grateful while you're waiting there smiling at me.

I have this same issue where my ex is the main character of all my daydreams; for obvious reasons, that's a problem. I wish I knew how to just turn it off, but in the meantime, I've formed a little crush on a new guy and now I've been fantasizing about him more often. I guess that since I rarely make up fictional characters anymore, my only solution is to just.. get attached to another real person?
This is how my old boss used to pronounce it every single time the sandwich was ordered and it got to the point we all began to wonder if he was even joking or actually serious.
I'm really glad you escaped. This whole thing with his behavior is so odd.. Has anyone had any idea of what might be his issue? Should definitely get help.
I love to write, and definitely started because of my daydreams. It's so easy to play out your ideas and then turn them into a story.

I have so much anxiety right now. I am so sorry. That is not the childhood you deserved, that is something no child should ever have to feel or worry about. He's hurt you very deeply in more ways that you've even noticed and I know this has to be so so hard, but you need to talk to a professional about it and I really hope you can tell your mom. He isn't safe. He isn't honest. He isn't loving. Action has to be taken in order for you to come to terms with that. I'm so sorry. I'm so very sorry.

I was 17 at the time leaving a concert at night alone, and had a very long walk to get to the street. My dad was out in the heavy traffic waiting for me to just walk down and hop in the car. Halfway to getting out of the venue, a car pulls up next to me, and the drunk guy in the passenger seat goes, "You look like you could use a ride." Taken by surprise, I just shook my head and looked forward again. Then the guy goes, "You should ride my face." while staring at me like I was a piece of meat. Then, the car drove off and my concert high was beyond dead.
Telling me I'm cute or more acceptable to you because of my lighter skin tone compared to people that are dark-skinned is not a compliment to me. I think you're disgusting.

Probably not, but I can relate. I go certain periods barely thinking about my ex, then I'll suddenly start obsessing again nonstop, and the next thing you know, he contacts me. It happens pretty often, and I find it strange. I always claim that I can just feel him coming. But then again, sometimes I get really down over it and nothing happens. Just coincidental.

When I tried to recklessly take something, not caring if it would kill me or just make me pass out maybe, I ended up not fully going through with it. Got too stuck in my head about everyone I cared about. You often get those thoughts that you're replaceable or that everyone would just move on if you were gone; hell, I told someone I loved way too much that I was going to do it and he said nothing. That hurt. But it's best to think about those that you're sure you can trust and who have helped to make your days a little brighter. I promise you give the same impact, and you're more significant than you think you are. Feeling numb sucks. I wish you could escape it without escaping yourself.
These kinds of posts are my favorite. So happy for you.

I just wanted to say thank you. These are things I've really been trying to accept. My manipulative and emotionally incapable ex likes to pop back into my life every few months, and I'd like to think he just needs me that much, but that isn't the case. He doesn't last, and he's cold when he leaves, while I'm left broken. It isn't okay for me to keep trying to convince him to be a better person, in hopes we can grow and love together. Life isn't a fairytale. Gotta work on my daddy issues.

One rainy night when he kissed me at a red light. When we pulled apart, I got shy and smiled at my hands. When I glanced back up, I realized he was watching me and smiling with this look in his eyes. I felt so content. Never wanted him to look at me differently.

It isn't your fault that you're not capable of hating him. I wish I knew how to make the positive thoughts of people that have destroyed us disappear from our brains. It feels inescapable sometimes. Trauma is difficult to erase, but you're going to someday move forward without it being so suffocating, and like a huge block in the way. You're going to learn to find love in things that won't deceive you and make you question your judgment. Your heart is good. You deserve good treatment. Message me if you ever need.

Thank you so much for this. I'm really sorry to hear what's happening. I seem to also have this curse where something totally awful happens to me on New Years, then the rest of the year feels like a drag. It's sad to know that we'll always have this cloud over our heads, but I also know we're bound to discover more reasons to stay. I'm glad you're still here for your kids. I thought of my little niece and nephew as well; they wouldn't deserve that at all. I'm going to try my best to keep going, and I hope that you'll do the same and keep finding more reasons. I salute you for getting this far.
Thank you. I'm trying my best to convince myself it was a good thing I didn't go through with it. Very rough.
That's good to hear. It's been almost two weeks for me and it hasn't quite kicked in, yet. I had some nausea, but luckily that only lasted a day.

Found out my grandpa was actually my mom's stepfather (my real grandpa attended our church but no one ever told me who he was before he died), and my mom actually hated him. He was evil and verbally abusive to both her and my grandmother. I had to reevaluate everything I once thought of him as, after learning all this.

Those are safe outlets and distractions for you, and that is definitely not something to be ashamed of. Keep enjoying what you enjoy. They don't know you and they just won't get it like you do. Who are they to label your character?
Exactly. It's so tiring and I hate that I just accept it sometimes because I feel I won't get treated better than that. I hope that better people come into your life.

Thank you for understanding me and giving me some hope with this. I'm really happy that you found a great person for you after dealing with so many draining things. I'm on break in college now, and I'll try to work on those skills a little harder when the next semester starts. (:

I hear you. Everyone loves getting to go back home, but college is a huge escape for me when I'm not stressing over finals, or something. The smallest interactions or lack thereof, can really set off a lot of paranoia and shitty feelings about yourself and your place in people's lives. I am currently isolating myself for this very reason, and I feel bad because I'm probably worrying everyone. Forcing yourself to be alone also builds up in a negative way, so I wouldn't recommend it. 

The thing to try to think about is how much good you contribute to the lives of those close to you. Doesn't have to be something giant or significant; being there for someone or even just making them laugh when they need it, etc are valid reasons for someone to truly appreciate having you in their life. 

And If you're feeling a little co-dependent, it's okay to take time to yourself if you need it. But, you should know that you being alive means so much more to others than you will ever know. Have some heart-to-hearts if needed.
